headline.zh-CN: 恢复历史版本问题的视觉区分
headline.en: Restore visual distinction for historical issues

summary.zh-CN: 历史版本问题恢复弱化显示，当前版本的反馈保持突出，便于浏览跨版本评审记录。
summary.en: Historical issues are visually subdued again, keeping current-version feedback prominent when browsing reviews across versions.

title.zh-CN: 按曲目当前版本区分视觉层级
title.en: Distinguish issues using the track's current version

description.zh-CN: 历史源音频和母带版本的问题以较低不透明度显示，继续支持查看、试听及原有权限内的操作。列表以曲目当前版本为基准，A/B 切换时保持这一视觉层级，波形标记继续跟随实际播放的音频。
description.en: Issues from historical source and master versions use reduced opacity while retaining viewing, playback, and permitted actions. The list stays anchored to the track's current version during A/B switching, while waveform markers continue to follow the audio being played.
